get_publication_info.description: Look up a Substack publication's public feed metadata: its title, description, homepage URL, author, cover image, language, and how many posts are currently in the feed. Useful for confirming a publication exists and grabbing its display details before pulling posts.

mock_response.author: Casey Newton
mock_response.description: Casey Newton on the intersection of tech and democracy.
mock_response.title: Platformer

get_publication_info.name: get_publication_info

parameters.description: The Substack publication to read. Use the subdomain (e.g. 'platformer'), the full Substack URL (e.g. 'https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com'), or a custom domain. A trailing '/feed' is optional.
parameters.name: publication

returns.description: Channel-level metadata for the publication feed.

author.description: Publication author / managing editor. May be empty.

feed_url.description: The resolved RSS feed URL that was fetched.

image_url.description: Publication cover/logo image URL. May be empty.

language.description: Feed language code, e.g. 'en'. May be empty.

last_build_date.description: When the feed was last built (RFC 822). May be empty.

post_count_in_feed.description: Number of posts currently present in the feed.

list_podcast_episodes.description: List a Substack publication's most recent podcast episodes: the feed items that carry an audio file. Each episode includes its title, URL, publish date, summary, and audio details (direct file URL, MIME type, size, duration, and episode/season numbers). Useful for tracking a Substack podcast or pulling the latest episode's audio into a workflow.

episodes.author: Ezra Klein
episodes.summary: A conversation about labor and automation.
episodes.title: What the AI boom means for workers

list_recent_posts.description: List the most recent posts from a Substack publication, newest first, with each post's title, URL, author, publish date, summary, and full content (as both HTML and plain text). Use this to pull a newsletter's latest articles into a workflow, for example to summarize the newest post or repost it elsewhere.

search_posts.description: Search a Substack publication's recent posts for a keyword or phrase. Matches the title, summary, author, and full text of each post in the feed (case-insensitive) and returns the matching posts. Because Substack's feed only carries the most recent ~20 posts, this searches recent posts, not the full archive.

description: Read public Substack publications through their official RSS feeds. List and search recent posts (with full content), fetch publication metadata, and track podcast episodes. Read-only and keyless: no Substack account or API key is required.
